Read-only search on this machine's D:\ drive. Change nothing, copy nothing, delete nothing, no installs, no scheduled tasks, no visible windows.

Steps:

4. For every image file found in steps 2-3 that is dated 2026-09-21..23, describe what it shows (open it and look): is it a handwritten sign-in sheet, a group photo, a slide, other.
